A '''null-grav trampoline''' was a piece of high-tech exercise equipment found in the training and recreation center of some [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] installations. The [[Imperial Aquatic Garrison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sedri/Legends|Sedri]] had two null-grav trampolines, one installed on the floor and the other on the ceiling.<ref name="BGS">''[[Battle for the Golden Sun]]''</ref>
